subject: Performance SLO & Load Test Coordination – Next Steps
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@finwise.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Performance SLO & Load Test Coordination – Next Steps

Hi Alice –

Great to meet earlier – thanks for the call. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align on the customer-led load test: 

Recap of requirements we heard
- Latency/SLOs: p95 < 200–250ms end-to-end for streaming completions (your app needs this for interactive UI flows)
- Throughput/Concurrency: target sustained ~1,000 RPS across endpoints during peak; roughly 200–300 concurrent streaming sessions
- Streaming: need chunked/streaming responses with low tail latency, abort/resume behavior expected
- Auth: test account/token + scoped test dataset; non-production data only

What we need from FinWise to run customer-led load test
1) The load script you prefer (k6 or Locust) – if you send the k6 script we can iterate locally.
2) Preferred test window(s) and expected ramp pattern (steady-state vs. spike).
3) List of load generator IPs to allowlist.
4) A test account email we can use (or we can create a scoped test token once we have the account).
5) Any specific payload sizes or prompt distribution to replicate production.

Our deliverables
- Provide a scoped test token and test endpoint (non-prod)
- Provide Redwood IPs for allowlisting and a short runbook (MOP) we can follow during the window
- Work with you to validate script and run one small smoke test before the window

Proposed next steps
- Alice: send k6/Locust script + preferred windows (ETA: EOD tomorrow)
- FinWise infra: send load generator IPs to add to our allowlist
- Redwood: we'll create a test token and share IPs + MOP by EOD Friday

Thanks – cc'ing Marissa and Rishi to lead the run and infra coordination.
— Logan
Logan Wright
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0182

From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@finwise.com>

Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 12:02:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Performance SLO & Load Test Coordination – Next Steps

Thanks, Logan –

Appreciate the recap. Confirming the key targets from our side: 
- p95 (end-to-end, including client+network): <= 200ms for interactive flows
- Sustained throughput target: 1,000 RPS across the inference endpoints during peak test (we'll do a 1-hour steady-state)
- Concurrency: plan for ~250 concurrent streaming sessions
- Streaming specifics: expect a ~1.2s average token interval, about 40 tokens per response on average; we care about partial-chunk arrival times

Attached is the updated k6 script we've been using (finwise_k6_script_v2.js). We'll run the first coordinated test in the morning UTC-friendly window: 2027-02-28 14:00–15:30 UTC (that maps to 09:00–10:30 ET). Please confirm you can support that window.

Load generator IPs to allowlist: 18.201.23.45, 18.201.23.46, 34.223.11.12

Please create a test account for: test-load@finwise.com (scoped to non-prod dataset). We can provide a small sample of production-like prompts if helpful.

Forwarding your original email below for context.

Best,
Alice

Head of Platform Engineering, FinWise
